**IMPORTANT**: If you are taking part in our network test events, add the following to your launch options: +tracerudp=3 +recordNetworkZiplocs
If you encounter issues, send the RUDP logs (lmu/userdata/log/rudp) to a !ticket with the race event name, date, time and timezone.
If you are running on a low/mid spec system, ensure you [check you can run the larger grids](https://guide.lemansultimate.com/hc/en-gb/articles/15769559223439-Performance-Optimization-Guide) smoothly (62 cars, the day to night to day transition, rain/wet track) in single player before registering to a race. You may need to significantly reduce your graphics settings (lowest), set FSR to ultra performance, increase your pagefile size in Windows to over 32GB. If you cannot run this event smoothly, do not register for it.
